main_body: A tall brown body about 30 rows high, with a flat olive-green slab or drape on top (rows 1-11) and a grey stone strip at the base (row 42). The brown area has scribbled dark and magenta shapes in its upper half and a large empty brown block below.
top_band: Pale olive-green, rows 1-11, a flat single-colour fill with a scalloped lower edge. It reads as a hanging cloth or curtain, or a vertical panel, not a horizontal surface.
evidence: Down the middle column I see a flat olive block (rows 1-11), then a ragged dark-brown scallop edge, then brown (rows 12-41) and grey stone (row 42). There is no distinct front-edge line, only the ragged scallop. The dark band under the green is not a clean eave shadow. Nothing on the front is drawn inset. The green fill has no foreshortened horizontal depth, so it reads as a drape or vertical face. The brown face is a large flat block with a scribble of detail on top. The object is also tall (43 rows) and does not read as low furniture. Fails as a front elevation.

style.evidence: The olive top is a single flat colour over about 30x10 pixels. The lower brown body is a large flat fill of about 30x14 pixels with almost no grain. The dark scribble shapes are inconsistent and unclear, and the magenta spots look random. The material ramps have only 2-3 steps, against the reference stall and well, which have clear tile highlights, stone shading and wood grain. Tiles in the lower half carry only 1-3 colours. It looks thinner and flatter than the references.
